written_at_utc: 2026-09-27, before any strategy result was computed

cost_model.default: US Intro tier TAKER 0.90% per side (Coinbase Advanced, effective 2026-09-16, docs/coinbase_api_notes.md s3.1) + per-product slippage = median $10k market-order cost vs mid from book_snapshot (includes half-spread), floor 2 bps, fallback 20 bps for products not in the snapshot
cost_model.execution: signal on daily close t (UTC day), trade at open of day t+1 (=close t + a few seconds); open-to-open returns; delisted/suspended holding sold at its last close

windows.rolling_origin: expanding window from 2018-01-01, re-select at each year end 2020..2025, trade next calendar year

selection_rule: per family and per asset set: highest TRAIN Sharpe (daily, 365-day annualisation, rf=0) net of default costs; tie -> lower turnover. Test numbers of ALL configs are also reported (median) to show selection robustness.

A_trend.basket_rebalance: entries/exits on signal flips; drifted weights reset to 1/N at month start only if |w-1/N| > 0.5/N

C_xsec_momentum.rebalance: weekly, signal Sunday close, trade Monday 00:00 UTC open; equal weight 1/k; continuing names re-weighted only if |w-1/k| > 0.5/k

D_hourly_meanrev_control.rule: z = h-hour return / its 30-day (720h) rolling stdev at close of hour t; if flat and z <= z_entry buy at open t+1, sell at open t+1+hold; equal capital per product

E_baselines: monthly DCA into BTC over the window
